_comment: Every tool that declares reach anyone, with the reason it is safe: the in-code guard it relies on (callers list, presence proof, own-scope check, held at the Gate), or read-only. A tool with a mutating verb in its name needs a reason that names a guard; read-only does not count. PENDING reasons are tracked and shrink. test/reach-anyone.test.js fails on an anyone with no entry.

github.accounts.reason: read-only: names, logins and avatars of connected accounts, never a token; callers list is the person's surfaces plus first-party modules (checked in code)

github.mentions.resolve.reason: read-only: one repo, PR or issue as context, marked outside text; callers are the person's surfaces and first-party modules named in code (checkModuleCaller), no model

github.mentions.search.reason: read-only: repo, PR and issue names and short hints; callers are the person's surfaces and first-party modules named in code (checkModuleCaller), no model

github.project.issue.get.reason: read-only: one issue with comments marked outside; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.project.issue.list.reason: read-only: a repo's issues, titles marked outside; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.project.local-init.reason: guard: callers list (person, agents, first-party projects/sessions/threads) and a project-grant check (inGrant); only a folder with no history becomes a repo, secret-looking files stay out of the first commit, nothing is overwritten

github.project.of.reason: read-only: which account and repo a project came from; callers are the person's surfaces and first-party sessions and threads (checkModuleCaller)

github.project.pr.comments.reason: read-only: a PR's comments marked person or outside; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.project.pr.get.reason: read-only: one PR shaped for the review card; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects; text from others is marked outside

github.project.pr.status.reason: read-only: checks, reviews and a ready verdict, no text from others; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.repos.reason: read-only: the repos an account can see; callers are the person's surfaces and module:sessions only (checkModuleCaller)

github.session.history.reason: read-only: a session's own commits and uncommitted count; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.session.push.reason: guard: pushes only the session's own vyre/<id> branch, by explicit refspec, never forced, to the project's recorded repo from a throwaway repo that reads none of the project's git config; the outgoing commits are secret-scanned and allow_secret counts only for a person or a call the person's words asked for; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.session.redo.reason: guard: restores only what github.session.undo saved for that session, refused when the branch moved on; never touches the default branch or a remote; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.session.undo.reason: guard: acts only on the session's own worktree and branch; nothing is deleted (the tip and unsaved work are kept under a ref and github.session.redo restores them); never touches the default branch or a remote; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects
